title: Agent-native email
human_answer_md:
**Agent-native email** means an agent can open a mailbox, receive credentials, send and receive, and prove entitlement — without a human filling a web form.

**Honest status:** the email directory has a real `known` seed (AgentMail). That is **not** Certified. See [/directory/email.json](/directory/email.json).
